meta.title: 为何他们的缺点，能美成经典？
meta.title_en: Why Do Their Flaws Become Classics?

scenes.title_cn: 立论：缺点适配气质=辨识度
scenes.title_en: Thesis: Flaws That Fit the Aura Equal Distinctiveness
scenes.context: 出圈美人们美的各有辨识度，原因在于他们的脸都有不同缺点，但缺点完美适配气质。
sentences: 他们的脸都有不同的缺点，但缺点却完美适配他们的气质。
Each of their faces has its own flaw — but the flaw fits their aura perfectly.
flaw（缺点）/ aura（气质）
怎么美的各有辨识度？原因就在于缺点适配气质。
Why is each one beautiful in her own way? Because the flaw matches the temperament.
distinctiveness（辨识度）
paraphrase: Their so-called flaws are the secret weapon.
Each face tells its own story.
scenes.speak: Each of their faces has its own flaw — but the flaw fits their aura perfectly. Why is each one beautiful in her own way? Because the flaw matches the temperament.

scenes.title_cn: 王祖贤：地包天=美人三分抛
scenes.title_en: Joey Wong: Underbite as the One-Part Protrusion
scenes.context: 轻微地包天在脸上不是缺陷而是美人三分抛的完美诠释。额面与上颌骨量充足，正面看不出；下巴后缩才是嘴凸元凶。
sentences: 王祖贤侧面看轻微的地包天，在他脸上不是缺陷，反而是美人三分抛的完美诠释。
From the side Joey Wong has a slight underbite — on her it's not a flaw but the perfect reading of the classic one-part protrusion.
an underbite（地包天）
很多地包天不好看的原因就是下巴后缩，嘴本身就是向前凸的，下巴过于后缩只会加强嘴凸感。
Most underbites look bad because of a receding chin — the lips already protrude, and a set-back chin only makes it worse.
a receding chin（下巴后缩）
轻微的包天，他能诠释出倩女幽魂里小倩的身不由己、渴望真爱，也能演绎出白蛇的极致魅惑。
That slight underbite lets her play Little Qian's helpless longing in A Chinese Ghost Story, and the White Snake's ultimate allure.
helpless longing（身不由己的渴望）
paraphrase: A hint of forward projection as charm.
Enough underlying bone to carry it.
scenes.speak: From the side Joey Wong has a slight underbite — on her it's not a flaw but the perfect reading of the classic one-part protrusion. Most underbites look bad because of a receding chin — the lips already protrude, and a set-back chin only makes it worse. That slight underbite lets her play Little Qian's helpless longing in A Chinese Ghost Story, and the White Snake's ultimate allure.

scenes.title_cn: 李嘉欣：外阔颧骨的包裹之道
scenes.title_en: Michele Reis: Wide Cheekbones, Well Wrapped
scenes.context: 颧骨高外阔但不影响颜值——颧弓不会过宽、颞部饱满包裹、头包脸趋势、颧结节高光点位于面中部构成内收曲线，明艳张扬。
sentences: 按照现在的审美来看，你会觉得他颧骨高还有些外阔，但这也不能影响他的颜值。
By today's standards you'd say her cheekbones are high and wide — yet it can't hurt her beauty.
wide cheekbones（外阔的颧骨）
他的颞部是饱满的，颞部的宽度宽于颧弓，甚至二者之间能有很好的包裹关系。
Her temples are full and actually wider than the cheekbones, so the two wrap around each other well.
wrap around（包裹关系）
颧结节也就是颧骨高光点，并不是过于外阔的，而是位于面中部，构成视觉内收的曲线。
The cheekbone highlight sits not too far out but at the mid-face, tracing a visually tucking-in curve.
a tucking-in curve（内收曲线）
scenes.speak: By today's standards you'd say her cheekbones are high and wide — yet it can't hurt her beauty. Her temples are full and actually wider than the cheekbones, so the two wrap around each other well. The cheekbone highlight sits not too far out but at the mid-face, tracing a visually tucking-in curve.

scenes.title_cn: 黄圣依：高眼位长中庭=高智清冷
scenes.title_en: Huang Shengyi: High Eyes, Long Mid-Face, Cool Intelligence
scenes.context: 被吐槽高眼位长中庭，但换来高智感高级感；虎牙带来少女感；眉尾自然下落把凌厉感变成清冷感。
sentences: 长中庭高眼位，却给他带来了不一样的韵味、高智感、高级感。
The long mid-face and high-set eyes give her a rare charm — an air of intelligence and refinement.
an air of intelligence（高智感）
标志性的小虎牙和兔牙，给他带来甜美少女感。
Her signature small canines and bunny teeth give her a sweet, girlish charm.
signature small canines（标志性小虎牙）
通过自然下落的眉尾，能适当降低高眼位带来的凌厉感，取而代之的是清冷感。
Naturally falling brow tails ease the sharpness of the high-set eyes, replacing it with a cool, aloof air.
a cool, aloof air（清冷感）
scenes.speak: The long mid-face and high-set eyes give her a rare charm — an air of intelligence and refinement. Her signature small canines and bunny teeth give her a sweet, girlish charm. Naturally falling brow tails ease the sharpness of the high-set eyes, replacing it with a cool, aloof air.

scenes.title_cn: 总结：缺陷=辨识度，变美保留特色
scenes.title_en: Conclusion: Flaws Are Signatures — Keep Them
scenes.context: 大众眼中的缺陷在美人脸上是辨识度。变美的过程中可以在保留自身特色的同时找到更多变美方向。
sentences: 这些大众眼中的缺陷，在美人的脸上却是辨识度。
What the public calls flaws become signatures on a beautiful face.
signature（辨识度/标志）
我们在变美的过程中，是可以在保留自身特色的同时，找到更多变美的方向的。
On the road to looking better, we can keep our own traits and still find more directions to go.
keep our own traits（保留自身特色）
paraphrase: The thing you hate is the thing we remember.
scenes.speak: What the public calls flaws become signatures on a beautiful face. On the road to looking better, we can keep our own traits and still find more directions to go.

practice.a: The flaw fits the aura perfectly.
They wrap around each other well.
Enhance your look while keeping your own traits.

pitfalls: Keep the traits that fit your aura.
Check whether your bone structure supports it.
The star's flaw works because of surrounding bone mass and proportions.
Look at how they wrap, narrow, or tuck in relation to neighbors.
A cheekbone or underbite is good or bad only in context.
shifts: 见缺点就想修，追求无缺点的『标准脸』
先审美再变美，保留特色找适配方向
difficult_words: Each face has its own flaw.
A slight underbite reads as charm.
Ample bone mass carries the look.
The temples wrap around the cheekbones.
A tucking-in curve sharpens the look.
An air of intelligence and refinement.
A cool, aloof air replaces it.
footer_notes: 原视频为审美思辨口播（作者：张雅航），转录为繁体已转简体，英文为场景意译，适合跟读练习审美表达；ASR 专有名词已按语境校正（拳骨→颧骨、捏曲→颞部、妻仙女→七仙女、雅女→哑女、三分包→三分抛）。
